name: rhymix-vst3-host
description: Native VST3 plugin host: real audio processing proven end to end against Steinberg's ADelay example. iZotope RX 11 plugins return kNotImplemented from setProcessing() (a documented, DAW-tolerated quirk of that plugin family, not a host bug) but process() now succeeds anyway per real-DAW behavior; whether real DSP occurred for a given RX 11 tool/signal combo is unproven either way (see README.md).
